title: Your account and permissions
lede: What OME sets on your account and why. Useful when something you expected to see is missing.

blocks.text: OME configures your access under **Main Access Rights** when the account is created. Most areas offer full or restricted, and restricted can be scoped to particular folders rather than the whole institution. Below is the standard setup for a new pre-clerkship course director.

blocks.caption: Standard Main Access Rights for a new course director

blocks.title: Grading stays unchecked
blocks.text: Ticking Grading turns the account into a grader-only account, which takes away access a course director needs. The symptom is being able to see grading queues but not the question bank or the assessment builder. If that happens, email OME.

blocks.title: Why Categories is restricted
blocks.text: About nine years of items are tagged against the shared category tree. Renaming or moving a node quietly changes what past reports mean. If your course needs a category that does not exist, ask OME to add it.

When the External ID does not match what UH single sign-on sends, sign-in fails with the account-not-found error in [Account and sign-in](#account). That is the most common access problem by a distance.
